patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Cisco Webex and Zenzap share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Cisco Webex only if your buying job matches “Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published floors; Ca” rather than Zenzap's shape. Choose Zenzap only if your buying job matches “Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp groups — ” rather than Cisco Webex's shape. Workflow advantage: Cisco Webex leans business-phone, contact-center; Zenzap leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Cisco Webex and Zenzap share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Cisco Webex is Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published floors; Calling and Contact Center often quote-layered.; Zenzap is Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp groups — free tier, Pro $3/user/month yearly, Business+ $8 .
- Company-size focus: Cisco Webex (mid-market, enterprise) vs Zenzap (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Cisco Webex-leaning business-phone, contact-center vs Zenzap-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Cisco Webex — Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic; Zenzap — Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+.

Limitations — Cisco Webex: Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic; Full Calling + Contact Center depth is often EA/quote layered beyond Suite list floors; Zenzap: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+; Voice and video calls require Pro; call recording and transcription require Business+.

Poor-fit cases: Cisco Webex is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic · Zenzap is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+ · Avoid Cisco Webex if you actually need Zenzap's motion (Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
